title: Automatic Revocation of CPF Nominee Status when a Beneficiary Becomes an Ex-spouse following Divorce
what_it_is: Automatic Revocation of CPF Nominee Status when a Beneficiary Becomes an Ex-spouse following Divorce

sections.label: CPF nomination after divorce
sections.summary: A question asks whether the Central Provident Fund Act 1953 will be amended to automatically revoke a nomination when the beneficiary becomes an ex-spouse after divorce.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Manpower whether the Government will amend the Central Provident Fund Act 1953 to provide for the automatic revocation of a nomination when the beneficiary becomes an ex-spouse following a divorce.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: The Central Provident Fund (CPF) nomination scheme provides CPF members with the option to nominate recipients of their CPF monies upon their demise and the proportion of savings each nominee should receive.

sections.label: CPF nominations not revoked on divorce
sections.summary: CPF nominations are not revoked on divorce, as members may still intend to provide for ex-spouse and children, and the Board intends to remind divorced members to review nominations.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: Like wills, CPF nominations are not revoked in the event of a divorce as we recognise that the CPF member may still intend to provide for the ex-spouse and children from the marriage.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: The Board also intends to remind those members who have undergone divorce to review their nominations.

sections.label: Studying CPF nomination rules
sections.summary: The Ministry of Law is studying reform of the Wills Act 1838 rule on automatic revocation of wills on marriage, and MOM and the CPF Board will study the CPF nomination rules.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: The Ministry of Law is studying whether to reform the rule in the Wills Act 1838 that provides for the automatic revocation of wills in the event of marriage.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: The Ministry of Manpower (MOM) and the CPF Board will likewise study the CPF nomination rules, so that the policy remains relevant to the evolving needs and behaviours of our citizens.

sections.label: Reminding divorced members from May 2023
sections.summary: From May 2023 the CPF Board intends to remind members who have undergone divorce to review their nominations, and is working with relevant agencies for information on divorced members.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: As I mentioned in my reply, from May 2023, that means in about a month and a half, the CPF Board intends to remind members who have undergone a divorce to review their nominations.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: We are currently working with the relevant agencies for information on divorced members.
